name: @projexlight/sdk-analytics
summary: OLAP + lakehouse layer for ProjexCloud: declare rollup specs, cohorts, funnels, and canonical KPIs once; the warehouse layer materializes them across per-tenant Iceberg tables. Federation manifest (G11) lets a single query span multiple per-tenant app pools without rehydrating into one central warehouse. Foundation for any analytics blueprint + the BI fan-out via connector-snowflake.

events.name: analytics.rollup.materialized.v1
events.description: Per-spec rollup completed; downstream BI tools can poll for freshness.

events.name: analytics.cohort.computed.v1
events.description: Cohort definition resolved into a member set (refreshable on demand).

events.name: analytics.kpi.published.v1
events.description: Canonical KPI value published for the period. Source-of-truth for dashboards.

events.name: analytics.lakehouse.extracted.v1
events.description: Source pool data extracted into an Iceberg snapshot. Carries snapshot ref + row count.

events.name: analytics.federation.query.served.v1
events.description: Federation query spanning multiple pools served. Audit trail for cross-pool reads.

models.description: Declarative rollup definition: source tables, dimensions, aggregates, refresh cadence.
Named subject set: definition (SQL or rule list), refreshed_at, member_count.
Ordered-event sequence with conversion math + per-step retention.
Canonical KPI registry: name, formula, owner, refresh cadence.
Per-extract job row: source_pool, target_iceberg_table, snapshot_ref, status.
Catalog entry per Iceberg namespace this tenant publishes.
Which per-tenant tables map to which federated Iceberg tables (G11).
Query log for federated reads; powers SemanticPolicy audit + cost attribution.

hooks.name: registerRollupSpec
hooks.description: Declare a rollup spec; the worker materializes it on the spec's refresh cadence.

hooks.name: computeCohort
hooks.description: Resolve a cohort definition into its current member set.

hooks.name: publishKpi
hooks.description: Publish a canonical KPI value for a period; idempotent on (kpi, period).

hooks.name: extractToLakehouse
hooks.description: Push a source pool's data into an Iceberg snapshot; idempotent on (pool, table, period).

hooks.name: federatedQuery
hooks.description: Run a query across federated Iceberg bindings without rehydrating; respects SemanticPolicy decisions.

scenarios.title: Declare a daily MRR rollup
scenarios.when_to_use: Finance wants daily MRR snapshots. Declare the rollup spec once; worker materializes on the cadence.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Spec persisted; worker rebuilds the materialized rollup hourly. Emits analytics.rollup.materialized.v1 per pass.

scenarios.title: Publish the canonical 'monthly active accounts' KPI
scenarios.when_to_use: Single source of truth for the company metric; dashboards + investor decks all read from here.
scenarios.expected_outcome: KPI value persisted + emitted. Audit trail keeps source_query_hash so the number is reproducible end-to-end.

scenarios.title: Federation: query across 5 tenant pools without rehydration
scenarios.when_to_use: Cross-tenant analytics for an operator dashboard ('what's the average DAU across all enterprise tenants?'). Federation reads Iceberg snapshots in place — no central warehouse needed.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Single result set across pools. Each pool's contribution audited via analytics.federation.query.served.v1 for cost attribution + SemanticPolicy logging.

scenarios.title: Extract a tenant's per-app event stream into Iceberg
scenarios.when_to_use: Daily batch — push raw events from the app pool into the tenant's Iceberg namespace for BI tools to read.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Job row written; worker performs the extract + creates a new Iceberg snapshot. Emits analytics.lakehouse.extracted.v1 with the snapshot ref. connector-snowflake (and similar) can fan out from here.

scenarios.title: Define a cohort: 'tenants on Pro plan as of last month'
scenarios.when_to_use: Marketing + product use cohorts for retention + expansion analysis. Definitions cached; recomputed on demand.
scenarios.expected_outcome: Cohort persisted with the resolved member set. Subsequent funnel + retention queries reference cohort_id rather than re-resolving.

compliance_posture.notes: Per-tenant Iceberg namespaces keep tenant data isolated even in federated queries. Federation queries logged in lakehouse_query_log for SOX + SOC2 + tenant-level cost attribution. KPI publish events are immutable — corrections write a new value with reason; never overwrite.

pricing_skus.unit_description: per federated query (per-pool fan-out billed separately)
per GB extracted into the lakehouse
